notes: Settled (v1.1): a stream cut before response.completed after the connection closes is a transport failure (reference behaviour). v1.2 replacement for provider-17. Text-only builder replies are progress; completion requires finish alone with {} (§3.6). Shell-recipe builders expose shell, finish, and tool_output (§4.7).
